title: Te Tohutohu i Whakairohia i roto i te Whakaaro Nui
intro: Whakaarohia te tū i te taha o tētahi tangata e mōhiotia ana ehara i te mea mō āna merekara, mō āna rangatiratanga rānei, engari mō āna kupu e ārahi tonu ana i ngā ngākau i ēnei rā. I whiwhi tēnei pononga a Allah i tētahi taonga utu nui, ā, i ringihia e ia te whakawhetai ki roto i ngā tohutohu katoa i hoatu ki tētahi ākonga taitamariki e arohaina ana.
clues: I manaakitia ahau e Allah ki te whakaaro nui, ā, i whakahaua ahau kia whakawhetai mōna.
I kōrero ahau ki taku tama me te kupu whakatūpato mārie, me te aroha me te āwangawanga.
I mea atu ahau ki taku tama he hara nui te whakawhanaunga i a Allah ki tētahi atu.
I tohutohu ahau i taku tama kia whakatū i te inoi, kia whakahau i te tika, kia ārai i te he, kia manawanui hoki.
I whakatūpato ahau i taku tama kia kaua e tahuri whakakake, kaua hoki e hikoi whakahihi i runga i te whenua.
I whakaako ahau i taku tama kia ngāwari te tere, kia whakaiti hoki i te reo, ko te tangi a te kaihe te mea tino kaha rawa atu.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Dhul-Kifl te Tūroro
Lukmana te Whakaaro Nui
Te Tangata o ngā Māra e Rua
Tubba te Rangatira

trial.label: Taku Tohutohu Nui rawa atu
options: Te tohutohu i taku tamaiti kia kaua e hono atu ki a Allah
Te hanga i tētahi āka hei oranga mō te waipuke nui
Te whakamārama i te moemoeā a te rangatira i a ia e noho ana i te whare herehere
Te tū atu ki a Parao me ngā tohu whakamiharo
Te horomia e te ika nui i te moana
trial.answer: Te tohutohu i taku tamaiti kia kaua e hono atu ki a Allah

location.label: Koha i homai ki ahau
options: He tokotoko i huri hei nakahi
Te whakaaro nui me te whakawhetai ki a Allah
He torona e haria ana i roto i te kimo o te kanohi
He āka i hangaia ki te rakau kopara
He māra o ngā nikau me ngā waina
location.answer: Te whakaaro nui me te whakawhetai ki a Allah

outcome.label: Te Maumaharatanga ki ahau
options: I te mea i toremi tetahi i te waipuke mō te kore whakapono
Me te mea kua horomia e te whenua mō te whakapehapeha
Hei tauira o te whakawhetai me te tohutohu whakaaro nui a ngā mātua
Me te mea kua whakangaromia e te pahūtanga nui mai i te rangi
I te mea kua hurihia tetahi mō te takahi i te Hāpati
outcome.answer: Hei tauira o te whakawhetai me te tohutohu whakaaro nui a ngā mātua

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
